def add_vote_parties(
    period: int,
    mp_votes: pl.DataFrame,
    votes: pl.DataFrame,
    mp_info: pl.DataFrame,
    organs: pl.DataFrame,
    memberships: pl.DataFrame,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Add ``party``: the MP's club on the day of each vote (#101).

    The club is the latest membership that started on or before the vote
    date and had not ended before it. MPs with no such membership fall back
    to their latest club in the period (mp_info.party).

    Args:
        period: Electoral period number.
        mp_votes: hl_poslanec rows (id_poslanec, id_hlasovani, vysledek).
        votes: hl_hlasovani rows (id_hlasovani, datum).
        mp_info: Output of build_mp_info.
        organs: organy table.
        memberships: zarazeni table.

    Returns:
        mp_votes with the same rows and order plus a ``party`` column.
    """
    vote_dates = votes.select(
        "id_hlasovani", pl.col("datum").str.to_date("%d.%m.%Y", strict=False).alias("d")
    )
    keys = (
        mp_votes.select("id_poslanec", "id_hlasovani")
        .join(vote_dates, on="id_hlasovani", how="left")
        .join(
            mp_info.select("id_poslanec", "id_osoba", pl.col("party").alias("fallback")),
            on="id_poslanec",
            how="left",
        )
        .select("id_poslanec", "id_osoba", "d", "fallback")
        .unique()
        .drop_nulls(["id_osoba", "d"])
        .sort("d")
    )
    clubs = _club_memberships(period, organs, memberships).sort("od")
    # both sides are globally sorted by date, hence also within each id_osoba group
    at_date = keys.join_asof(
        clubs,
        left_on="d",
        right_on="od",
        by="id_osoba",
        strategy="backward",
        check_sortedness=False,
    )
    at_date = at_date.select(
        "id_poslanec",
        "d",
        pl.when(pl.col("do").is_null() | (pl.col("do") >= pl.col("d")))
        .then(pl.col("party"))
        .otherwise(None)
        .fill_null(pl.col("fallback"))
        .alias("party"),
    )
    return (
        mp_votes.join(vote_dates, on="id_hlasovani", how="left", maintain_order="left")
        .join(at_date, on=["id_poslanec", "d"], how="left", maintain_order="left")
        .drop("d")
    )

docs.text:
Manual corrections from the admin, applied on top of pipeline outputs (TASKS 2X).

One JSON file per period, {cache}/overrides/{period}.json::

{kind: {key: {...fields, "by": user, "at": iso time}}}

Kinds and keys:

  • vote_question / "<id_hlasovani>": question, question_en
  • brief / "<ct>": review (ok | hidden | edited) and, when edited, nazev, shrnuti
  • amendment_summary / "<ct>:<letter>": summary, summary_en
  • homepage_pick / "talked_about": ct (pin), hidden (tisk numbers), until (ISO date)

Only the admin writes this file; pipelines never touch it, so they cannot overwrite a correction. The readers apply it on every get_period.

def set_override(
    cache_dir: Path, period: int, kind: str, key: str, fields: dict[str, Any] | None, user: str
) -> None:
    """Add, replace or (``fields=None``) remove one correction.

    Args:
        cache_dir: Base cache directory.
        period: Electoral period.
        kind: One of KINDS.
        key: Record key (see module docstring).
        fields: Corrected fields, or None to delete the correction.
        user: Admin user making the change.

    Raises:
        ValueError: Unknown kind.
    """
    if kind not in KINDS:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown override kind {kind!r}")
    data = load_overrides(cache_dir, period)
    if fields is None:
        data[kind].pop(key, None)
    else:
        data[kind][key] = {
            **fields,
            "by": user,
            "at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        }
    path = overrides_path(cache_dir, period)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write_json_atomic(data, path)
    logger.info("[overrides] period {} {} {} by {}", period, kind, key, user)

def apply_briefs(briefs: dict[int, dict], ov: dict[str, dict[str, dict]]) -> None:
    """Apply brief reviews and edits (in place); a hidden brief is removed."""
    for key, rec in ov["brief"].items():
        ct = int(key)
        match rec.get("review"):
            case "hidden":
                briefs.pop(ct, None)
            case "ok" if ct in briefs:
                briefs[ct] = {**briefs[ct], "status": "ok", "edited": _edited(rec)}
            case "edited":
                old = briefs.get(ct) or {}
                cs = {
                    **(old.get("cs") or {}),
                    "nazev": rec.get("nazev", ""),
                    "shrnuti": rec.get("shrnuti", ""),
                }
                # English falls back to the corrected Czech text rather than the old AI one
                briefs[ct] = {**old, "cs": cs, "en": {}, "status": "ok", "edited": _edited(rec)}

def apply_amendment_summaries(
    amendment_data: dict[tuple[int, int], BillAmendmentData], ov: dict[str, dict[str, dict]]
) -> None:
    """Put corrected letter summaries into the amendment data (in place).

    shortcut: removing a correction keeps the edited text in memory until the
    amendment parquet is reloaded (next pipeline run or restart).
    """
    for key, rec in ov["amendment_summary"].items():
        ct_str, _, letter = key.partition(":")
        for bill in amendment_data.values():
            if str(bill.ct) != ct_str:
                continue
            for amend in bill.amendments:
                if amend.letter.strip().upper() == letter:
                    amend.summary = rec.get("summary", "")
                    amend.summary_en = rec.get("summary_en", "")
                    amend.summary_warning = False
                    amend.summary_reviewed = True

Compute each group's majority direction (YES vs NO).

A group's direction is YES when its YES votes outnumber its NO votes and vice versa; exact ties carry no direction and are dropped. Shared by loyalty (rebellion detection) and the amendment coalition analysis so the two can never drift apart.

def party_majority_direction(
    votes: pl.DataFrame,
    group_keys: Sequence[str] = _DEFAULT_GROUP_KEYS,
    direction_alias: str = "party_direction",
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Compute each group's majority direction (YES vs NO).

    A group's direction is YES when its YES votes outnumber its NO votes
    and vice versa; exact ties carry no direction and are dropped.
    Shared by loyalty (rebellion detection) and the amendment coalition
    analysis so the two can never drift apart.

    Args:
        votes: Frame with a "vysledek" column holding VoteResult values
            plus one column per group key.
        group_keys: Columns identifying a group (default vote + party).
        direction_alias: Name of the resulting direction column; its
            values are VoteResult.YES / VoteResult.NO.

    Returns:
        Grouped frame with yes_count, no_count, and the direction
        column; tied (direction-less) groups are filtered out.
    """
    return (
        votes.group_by(list(group_keys))
        .agg(
            (pl.col("vysledek") == VoteResult.YES).sum().alias("yes_count"),
            (pl.col("vysledek") == VoteResult.NO).sum().alias("no_count"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.when(pl.col("yes_count") > pl.col("no_count"))
            .then(pl.lit(VoteResult.YES))
            .when(pl.col("no_count") > pl.col("yes_count"))
            .then(pl.lit(VoteResult.NO))
            .otherwise(pl.lit(None))
            .alias(direction_alias)
        )
        .filter(pl.col(direction_alias).is_not_null())
    )

async def acquire(self, pipeline_type: str, period: int) -> bool:
    """Try to acquire the lock for a pipeline.

    Args:
        pipeline_type: Type of pipeline (e.g. "tisk", "amendment").
        period: Electoral period number.

    Returns:
        True if lock acquired, False if another pipeline is running.
    """
    if self._lock.locked():
        logger.warning(
            "[pipeline-lock] Rejected {}/{}: already running {}",
            pipeline_type,
            period,
            self._current,
        )
        return False

    await self._lock.acquire()
    pipeline_id = f"{pipeline_type}:{period}"
    self._current = PipelineInfo(
        pipeline_id=pipeline_id,
        pipeline_type=pipeline_type,
        period=period,
    )
    logger.info("[pipeline-lock] Acquired: {}", pipeline_id)
    return True

def release(self) -> None:
    """Release the pipeline lock."""
    if not self._lock.locked():

    self._current = None
    self._lock.release()
    logger.info("[pipeline-lock] Released: {}", pipeline_id)

        logger.debug("[runtime-config] No config file at {}, using .env defaults", path)
        return RuntimeConfig(**_defaults_from_env())

    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text("utf-8"))
        # Filter out unknown keys to handle schema changes gracefully
        known_fields = {
            f.name
            for f in RuntimeConfig.__dataclass_fields__.values()
            if not f.name.startswith("_")
        }
        filtered = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in known_fields}
        config = RuntimeConfig(**filtered)
        logger.info("[runtime-config] Loaded from {}", path)
        return config
    except Exception:
        logger.opt(exception=True).warning(
            "[runtime-config] Failed to load {}, using .env defaults", path
        )
        return RuntimeConfig(**_defaults_from_env())

def compute_pca_coords(data: PeriodData) -> list[dict]:
    """Compute 2D PCA coordinates for each MP based on voting patterns.

    Returns list of dicts with: mp_name, party, x, y
    """
    matrix, mp_info = _build_vote_matrix(data)

    # Center the data
    matrix_centered = matrix - matrix.mean(axis=0)

    # SVD-based PCA (no sklearn needed)
    U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(matrix_centered, full_matrices=False)
    coords_2d = U[:, :2] * S[:2]

    names = (mp_info.get_column("jmeno") + " " + mp_info.get_column("prijmeni")).to_list()
    parties = mp_info.get_column("party").to_list()

    return [
        {
            "mp_name": names[i],
            "party": parties[i] or "N/A",
            "x": float(coords_2d[i, 0]),
            "y": float(coords_2d[i, 1]),
        }
        for i in range(len(names))
    ]

def compute_cross_party_similarity(data: PeriodData, top: int | None = 20) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
    """Most-agreeing MP pairs from different clubs and across government/opposition (#104).

    Agreement = votes where both voted the same way / votes where both voted
    (yes, no, or abstained-or-did-not-vote; not logged in and excused do not
    count). The cross-club table counts only votes where the two MPs were in
    different clubs on that day. Pairs need SIMILARITY_MIN_SHARED_VOTES shared votes. The
    government x opposition table counts only votes where one MP's club was
    in government and the other's in opposition on that day.

    Args:
        data: Period data.
        top: Pairs per table (None = every eligible pair).

    Returns:
        {"cross_party": [...], "gov_opp": [...]}; each pair has names, parties,
        same, shared and agreement (0-1).
    """
    void_ids = data.void_votes.get_column("id_hlasovani")
    mp_votes = data.mp_votes.filter(~pl.col("id_hlasovani").is_in(void_ids)).with_columns(
        pl.col("vysledek").map_elements(vote_category, return_dtype=pl.String).alias("cat")
    )
    mp_ids = sorted(mp_votes.get_column("id_poslanec").unique().to_list())
    vote_ids = sorted(mp_votes.get_column("id_hlasovani").unique().to_list())
    info = pl.DataFrame({"id_poslanec": mp_ids}).join(data.mp_info, on="id_poslanec", how="left")
    names = (info.get_column("jmeno") + " " + info.get_column("prijmeni")).to_list()
    parties = info.get_column("party").to_list()

    same, both = _cross_club_counts(mp_votes, mp_ids, vote_ids)
    cross = _pairs(same, both, names, parties, lambda i, j: True, top)

    sides = _side_per_record(data, mp_votes)
    gov = _indicator_matrices(mp_votes.filter(sides == GOVERNMENT), mp_ids, vote_ids)
    opp = _indicator_matrices(mp_votes.filter(sides == OPPOSITION), mp_ids, vote_ids)
    s_go, b_go = _agreement_counts(gov, opp)
    gov_opp = _pairs(s_go + s_go.T, b_go + b_go.T, names, parties, lambda i, j: True, top)
    return {"cross_party": cross, "gov_opp": gov_opp}

def similarity_map(data: PeriodData) -> dict:
    """PCA map points scaled to an SVG viewBox, coloured by club, plus a legend (#116).

    Args:
        data: Period data.

    Returns:
        {"points": [{name, party, cx, cy, color}], "legend": [{party, color, side}],
        "width", "height"}.
    """
    coords = compute_pca_coords(data)
    if not coords:
        return {"points": [], "legend": [], "width": _MAP_W, "height": _MAP_H}
    xs = [c["x"] for c in coords]
    ys = [c["y"] for c in coords]
    span_x = (max(xs) - min(xs)) or 1.0
    span_y = (max(ys) - min(ys)) or 1.0
    points = [
        {
            "name": c["mp_name"],
            "party": c["party"],
            "cx": round(_MAP_PAD + (c["x"] - min(xs)) / span_x * (_MAP_W - 2 * _MAP_PAD), 1),
            "cy": round(_MAP_PAD + (c["y"] - min(ys)) / span_y * (_MAP_H - 2 * _MAP_PAD), 1),
            "color": CLUB_COLORS.get(c["party"], CLUB_COLOR_OTHER),
        }
        for c in coords
    ]
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for c in coords:
        counts[c["party"]] = counts.get(c["party"], 0) + 1
    legend = [
        {
            "party": party,
            "color": CLUB_COLORS.get(party, CLUB_COLOR_OTHER),
            "side": classify_party(party, data.coalition_parties),
            "count": n,
        }
        for party, n in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])
    ]
    return {
        "points": points,
        "legend": legend,
        "groups": _side_labels(points, data.coalition_parties),
        "width": _MAP_W,
        "height": _MAP_H,
    }

def speech_counts(index_html: str, day_pages: dict[str, str]) -> dict[int, dict[str, int]]:
    """Speeches per agenda item and day, without the chair's procedural turns.

    Args:
        index_html: Sitting index (bod anchors ``bN`` followed by day-page links).
        day_pages: ``{day page file: html}`` (TOC of speakers under ``qN`` anchors).

    Returns:
        ``{bod: {iso date: speeches}}``.
    """
    out: dict[int, dict[str, int]] = {}
    merged = _MERGED_RE.search(index_html)
    # the merged-debate blocks follow the last agenda item; keep them out of its section
    items = index_html[: merged.start()] if merged else index_html
    for bod in {int(m.group(1)) for m in _BOD_ANCHOR_RE.finditer(items)}:
        for page, anchor in _find_bod_day_pages(items, bod):
            _add_speeches(out, [bod], day_pages.get(page, ""), anchor)
    # "Sloučená rozprava k bodům 2 a 3": its speeches count for every merged item (#108)
    for m in _MERGED_RE.finditer(index_html):
        bods = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+", m.group(1))]
        for page, anchor in _DAY_LINK_RE.findall(m.group(2)):
            _add_speeches(out, bods, day_pages.get(page, ""), anchor)
    return out

def load_speeches(cache_dir: Path, period: int) -> dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, int]]:
    """All speech counts of a period: ``{(schuze, bod): {iso date: speeches}}``."""
    out: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, int]] = {}
    for path in (cache_dir / VOTE_STENO_DIR / str(period) / SPEECHES_DIR).glob("*.json"):

    return out

Legislative steps as sentences with a verb, and phase labels (#106, #108, #110, #111).

"30. 10. · Zákon dostal k podpisu prezident. Rozhodnout musí do 14. 11." instead of the raw history outcome ("doručeno prezidentovi"). Sentences are keyed by the history stage type and outcome (services/tisk/io/history_stages); the noun follows the document type (návrh, smlouva, zpráva, interpelace) and a bill becomes "zákon" once the Chamber passed it.

def step_sentence(
    stage_type: str,
    outcome: str,
    details: str,
    tab: str,
    lang: str = "cs",
    submitter: str | None = None,
    before_chamber: bool = False,
) -> str:
    """One history step as a sentence with a verb.

    Args:
        stage_type: History stage type ("1_cteni", "prezident", …).
        outcome: Stage outcome ("" when none).
        details: The stage's full text (used for non-bill documents).
        tab: Document type (law_filters.TABS).
        lang: "cs" or "en".
        submitter: Submitter kind of a bill (vlada/poslanci/senat/kraje), names the
            first step ("Vláda předložila návrh.").
        before_chamber: The step is a Senate bill's own Senate proceeding, before the
            Chamber got it, so it is still a "návrh", not a "zákon".

    Returns:
        The sentence; "" when the step has no known wording.
    """
    acc, nom, en = _nouns(tab)
    if tab == "navrhy" and stage_type == "ps" and submitter in _SUBMITTED:
        if _SUBMITTED_RE.search(details):
            return _SUBMITTED[submitter][lang == "en"]
    if tab != "navrhy":
        for pattern, pair in _DETAIL_SENTENCES:
            if pattern.search(details):
                return (pair[1] if lang == "en" else pair[0]).format(a=acc, N=nom, e=en)
    if tab != "navrhy" and stage_type in _BILL_ONLY:
        return ""  # readings of treaties and reports: psp.cz's own sentence is clearer
    if stage_type == "ps" and not outcome and not _SUBMITTED_RE.search(details):
        return ""  # other Chamber notes ("zařazen na pořad") have no fixed wording
    pair = _SENTENCES.get((stage_type, outcome or "")) or _SENTENCES.get((stage_type, ""))
    if not pair:
        return ""
    if tab == "navrhy" and stage_type in _LAW_STAGES and not before_chamber:
        acc, nom = "zákon", "Zákon"
    return (pair[1] if lang == "en" else pair[0]).format(a=acc, N=nom, e=en)

def before_chamber(tisk: TiskInfo, stage: object) -> bool:
    """Whether a Senate step comes before the Chamber got the bill (a Senate bill)."""
    stages = tisk.history.stages if tisk.history else []
    if not getattr(stage, "stage_type", "").startswith("senat"):
        return False
    for s in stages:
        if s is stage:
            return True
        if not s.stage_type.startswith("senat"):
            return False
    return False

def president_deadline(tisk: TiskInfo) -> date | None:
    """Last day the President can decide, when the law waits for him; else None."""
    stages = tisk.history.stages if tisk.history else []
    last = stages[-1] if stages else None
    if not last or last.stage_type != "prezident" or last.outcome != "doručeno prezidentovi":
        return None
    delivered = _date(last.details) or _date(last.date)
    return delivered + timedelta(days=PRESIDENT_DAYS) if delivered else None

def phase_key(tisk: TiskInfo) -> str:
    """Translation key of the phase label ("ve výborech", "platný zákon", …) of a bill."""
    history = tisk.history
    if history is None:
        return "phl.before_1st"
    if key := _STATUS_PHASES.get(history.current_status):
        return key
    chamber = [s for s in history.stages if s.stage_type in _CHAMBER_PHASES]
    return _CHAMBER_PHASES[chamber[-1].stage_type] if chamber else "phl.before_1st"

def normalize_vote_codes(
    mp_votes: pl.DataFrame, votes: pl.DataFrame, excuses: pl.DataFrame
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Fold 'N' into 'B' and turn excused '@' records into 'M'.

    Args:
        mp_votes: hl_poslanec rows (id_poslanec, id_hlasovani, vysledek).
        votes: hl_hlasovani rows (needs id_hlasovani, datum, cas).
        excuses: omluvy rows for the period (id_poslanec, den, od, do).

    Returns:
        mp_votes with the same rows and order, codes normalised.
    """
    keys = _excused_keys(mp_votes, votes, excuses).with_columns(pl.lit(True).alias("_excused"))
    return (
        mp_votes.join(keys, on=["id_hlasovani", "id_poslanec"], how="left", maintain_order="left")
        .with_columns(
            pl.when(pl.col("_excused"))
            .then(pl.lit(VoteResult.EXCUSED.value))
            .when(pl.col("vysledek") == VoteResult.NO_ALT)
            .then(pl.lit(VoteResult.NO.value))
            .otherwise(pl.col("vysledek"))
            .alias("vysledek")
        )
        .drop("_excused")
    )

def check_vote_totals(period: int, votes: pl.DataFrame, mp_votes: pl.DataFrame) -> int:
    """Log when per-MP records disagree with the hl_hlasovani summary.

    Checks pro = yes, proti = no, zdrzel + nehlasoval = abstained and
    prihlaseno = yes + no + abstained, and reports unknown codes.

    Args:
        period: Period number (for the log line).
        votes: hl_hlasovani rows.
        mp_votes: Normalised hl_poslanec rows.

    Returns:
        Number of votes whose totals disagree.
    """
    unknown = mp_votes.filter(~pl.col("vysledek").is_in(list(VOTE_CATEGORIES))).get_column(
        "vysledek"
    )
    if unknown.len():
        logger.error(
            "Period {}: {} vote records with unknown codes {}",
            period,
            unknown.len(),
            sorted(unknown.unique().to_list()),
        )
    counts = mp_votes.group_by("id_hlasovani").agg(category_count_exprs())
    joined = votes.join(counts, on="id_hlasovani")
    bad = joined.filter(
        (pl.col("pro") != pl.col("yes"))
        | (pl.col("proti") != pl.col("no"))
        | (pl.col("zdrzel") + pl.col("nehlasoval") != pl.col("abstained"))
        | (pl.col("prihlaseno") != pl.col("yes") + pl.col("no") + pl.col("abstained"))
    )
    if bad.height:  # a handful per period are inconsistencies in the psp.cz source itself
        logger.warning(
            "Period {}: {} votes where MP records disagree with the summary, e.g. {}",
            period,
            bad.height,
            bad.get_column("id_hlasovani").head(5).to_list(),
        )
    return bad.height

def vote_kind(data: PeriodData, vote_id: int) -> str | None:
    """Kind from amendment data ('final' / 'amendment'), else from the steno rules (#102)."""
    ctx = data.get_amendment_for_vote(vote_id)
    if ctx is not None and (ctx[3] or ctx[2]):
        return "final" if ctx[3] else "amendment"
    kind = data.vote_steno.get(vote_id, {}).get("kind")
    return None if kind in (None, "other") else kind

def filter_kind(votes: pl.DataFrame, data: PeriodData, kind: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Keep votes of the chosen kind (KIND_FILTERS); votes of unknown kind match none."""
    kinds = KIND_FILTERS.get(kind)
    if not kinds:
        return votes
    ids = [v for v in votes.get_column("id_hlasovani").to_list() if vote_kind(data, v) in kinds]
    return votes.filter(pl.col("id_hlasovani").is_in(ids))

def group_result(rows: list[dict]) -> str:
    """Translation key of the agenda item's outcome in a group ("" when none is decisive)."""
    for kind, passed, failed in _GROUP_RESULTS:
        hits = [r for r in rows if r.get("kind") == kind and not r["is_void"]]
        if not hits:
            continue
        if any(r["vysledek"] == "A" for r in hits):
            return passed
        if failed:
            return failed
    return ""

def reading_at(data: PeriodData, tisk_ct: int | None, schuze: int) -> str:
    """Reading ("1_cteni" …) the bill was in at a sitting, from its history ("" if unknown)."""
    tisk = (
        next((t for t in data.tisk_lookup.values() if t.ct == tisk_ct), None) if tisk_ct else None
    )
    stages = tisk.history.stages if tisk and tisk.history else []
    return next(
        (
            s.stage_type
            for s in reversed(stages)
            if s.session_number == schuze and "cteni" in s.stage_type
        ),
        "",
    )

def proposer_view(data: PeriodData, names: str, vote_id: int | None) -> dict | None:
    """Proposers with their club on the vote day and the verb form (#114).

    Args:
        data: Period data (mp_info with pohlavi, mp_votes with the club per vote).
        names: Proposer names from the steno record, joined by ", " (may be surnames).
        vote_id: The vote, for the club on that day.

    Returns:
        ``{"verb": key, "text": "Karel Haas (ODS)"}``, or None without names. A name
        that matches no MP, or several, is shown as written, without a club.
    """
    if not names:
        return None
    info = data.mp_info
    has_gender = "pohlavi" in info.columns
    parts: list[str] = []
    women: list[bool | None] = []
    for name in names.split(", "):
        words = name.split()
        hits = info.filter(pl.col("prijmeni") == words[-1])
        if len(words) > 1:
            hits = hits.filter(pl.col("jmeno") == " ".join(words[:-1]))
        if hits.height != 1:
            parts.append(name)
            women.append(True if name.endswith("ová") else None)
            continue
        mp = hits.row(0, named=True)
        club = mp["party"]
        if vote_id and "party" in data.mp_votes.columns:
            row = data.mp_votes.filter(
                (pl.col("id_hlasovani") == vote_id) & (pl.col("id_poslanec") == mp["id_poslanec"])
            )
            club = row["party"][0] if row.height else club
        parts.append(f"{mp['jmeno']} {mp['prijmeni']}" + (f" ({club})" if club else ""))
        women.append(mp["pohlavi"] != "M" if has_gender and mp["pohlavi"] else None)
    return {"verb": _verb(women), "text": ", ".join(parts)}

def vote_story(data: PeriodData, info: dict, lang: str = "cs") -> dict:
    """What the vote detail says around the numbers (#114).

    Args:
        data: Period data.
        info: Vote info with ``kind``, ``steno`` (vote_question), ``tisk_ct``, ``schuze``.
        lang: Language.

    Returns:
        Dict with ``consequence`` (translation key or ""), ``pro`` (what Pro meant),
        ``final_meaning`` (True for the bill as a whole), ``proposer``, ``reading``,
        ``tisk_title`` and the linked votes ``invalid`` / ``challenger`` / ``repeat``,
        ``chair_repeat`` and ``repeats``.
    """
    st = info.get("steno") or {}
    kind = info.get("kind") or ""
    passed = info.get("vysledek") == "A"
    cons = _CONSEQUENCES.get(kind, ("", ""))[0 if passed else 1]
    challenge = data.vote_steno.get(st.get("invalid_by") or 0, {})
    tisk = next((t for t in data.tisk_lookup.values() if t.ct == info.get("tisk_ct")), None)
    brief = (tisk.brief or {}).get("en" if lang == "en" else "cs") if tisk and tisk.brief else None
    return {
        "consequence": "" if st.get("invalid_by") else cons,
        "pro": st.get("pro", ""),
        "final_meaning": kind == "final",
        "proposer": proposer_view(data, st.get("proposer", ""), info.get("id_hlasovani")),
        "reading": reading_at(data, info.get("tisk_ct"), info.get("schuze") or 0),
        "tisk_title": (brief or {}).get("nazev") or info.get("tisk_nazev") or "",
        "invalid": bool(st.get("invalid_by")),
        "challenger": (
            proposer_view(data, challenge.get("proposer", ""), st.get("invalid_by")) or {}
        ).get("text", ""),
        "repeat": _vote_brief(data, st.get("repeated_as")),
        "chair_repeat": _vote_brief(data, st.get("chair_repeated_as")),
        "repeats": _vote_brief(data, st.get("repeats")),
        "steno_pending": is_recent(info.get("datum") or ""),
    }

Votes are anchored at their announcement in the steno (vote_steno_text); the text since the previous announcement is the lead-in. The LLM extracts kind, question, what "Pro" meant, the proposer and a verbatim quote. The quote must be in the steno and the

def generate_vote_steno_sync(
    period: int,
    cache_dir: Path,
    progress_callback: Callable[[int, int], None] | None = None,
    cancel_check: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
) -> int:
    """Crawl the steno of every sitting with votes and write the vote records.

    Args:
        period: Electoral period.
        cache_dir: Base cache directory.
        progress_callback: Called with (sittings done, total).
        cancel_check: Raises PipelineCancelled when the run is stopped.

    Returns:
        Number of votes with a record.
    """
    votes = pl.read_parquet(cache_dir / PARQUET_DIR / f"hl_hlasovani_{period}.parquet")
    llm = create_llm_client()
    if not llm.is_available():
        logger.warning("[vote steno] LLM not available, skipping period {}", period)
        return 0
    sittings = sorted(votes["schuze"].unique().to_list())
    total = 0
    for i, schuze in enumerate(sittings, 1):
        if cancel_check:
            cancel_check()
        out_dir = cache_dir / speeches.VOTE_STENO_DIR / str(period)
        sitting_votes = votes.filter(pl.col("schuze") == schuze)
        records, anchored = _sitting_records(
            llm, period, schuze, sitting_votes, cache_dir, out_dir / f"{schuze}.json"
        )
        if records:
            write_json_atomic(records, out_dir / f"{schuze}.json")
            _write_check(out_dir, schuze, anchor_check(sitting_votes, anchored), period)
        counts = speeches.sitting_speeches(period, schuze, cache_dir)
        if counts:
            write_json_atomic(counts, out_dir / speeches.SPEECHES_DIR / f"{schuze}.json")
        known = sum(r.get("status") in ("ok", "uncertain") for r in records.values())
        total += len(records)
        logger.info(
            "[vote steno] period {} sitting {}: {}/{} votes, {} with question",
            period,
            schuze,
            len(records),
            sitting_votes.height,
            known,
        )
        if progress_callback:
            progress_callback(i, len(sittings))
    return total

def load_anchor_checks(cache_dir: Path, period: int) -> list[dict[str, int]]:
    """Agenda items with an anchoring mismatch: ``[{schuze, bod, votes, anchored}]``."""
    out: list[dict[str, int]] = []
    for path in sorted(
        (cache_dir / speeches.VOTE_STENO_DIR / str(period) / CHECKS_DIR).glob("*.json")
    ):
        try:
            for bod, c in json.loads(path.read_text()).items():
                out.append({"schuze": int(path.stem), "bod": int(bod), **c})
        except (ValueError, OSError):
            logger.opt(exception=True).warning("Unreadable anchor check file {}", path)
    return sorted(out, key=lambda c: (c["schuze"], c["bod"]))

def sitting_pages(
    period: int, schuze: int, cache_dir: Path, refresh: bool = False
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Download (or read cached) all steno sub-pages of a sitting, in order.

    Day-page TOCs skip pages without a speaker anchor, so the whole numeric range
    between the first and last linked page is fetched.

    Args:
        period: Electoral period.
        schuze: Sitting number.
        cache_dir: Base cache directory.
        refresh: Re-fetch the index and day pages (sitting may still grow).

    Returns:
        ``(page name, html)`` list; empty when the steno is not published.
    """
    sdir = _steno_cache_dir(cache_dir, period)
    if refresh:
        for stale in [sdir / f"index_{schuze}.html", *sdir.glob(f"{schuze}_day_*")]:
            stale.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    index = _download_index(period, schuze, cache_dir)
    if not index:
        return []
    base = PSP_STENO_BASE_TEMPLATE.format(year=PERIOD_YEARS[period], session=schuze)
    nums: set[int] = set()
    for day in _day_pages(index, schuze):
        day_html = _download_day_page(base, day, period, schuze, cache_dir) or ""
        if not day_html:
            continue
        for link in _SUBPAGE_LINK_RE.findall(day_html):
            if m := _SUBPAGE_NUM_RE.match(link):
                nums.add(int(m.group(1)))
    pages: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for n in range(min(nums), max(nums) + 1) if nums else ():
        name = f"s{n:06d}.htm"
        cached = (sdir / f"{schuze}_sub_{name.replace('.htm', '.html')}").exists()
        page = _download_subpage(base, name, period, schuze, cache_dir)
        if not cached:
            time.sleep(PSP_REQUEST_DELAY)
        if page:
            pages.append((name, page))
    return pages

Steno text around votes, without the LLM (#102).

Every vote announcement in a steno page is a link <a href="/sqw/hlasy.sqw?G=<id>" id="hN">Hlasování číslo N</a>, přihlášeno …. Speakers also link earlier votes by the same href ("revokuje usnesení přijaté v hlasování č. 277"), so a vote is anchored at its announcement (followed by "přihlášen"), falling back to its first link when no announcement exists. The text between two announcements is the lead-in to the later vote.

def normalize_vote_anchors(pages: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Rewrite vote links so the amendment parser anchors votes like ``sitting_text``.

    The chosen announcement becomes "Hlasování číslo N" (covers "hlasování 278" and
    "(číslo 273"); any other link to a vote, e.g. a speaker citing an older vote,
    becomes "(odkaz na hlasování N)", which no vote-number pattern matches.

    Args:
        pages: ``(page name, html)`` in page order.

    Returns:
        The pages with rewritten vote links.
    """
    chosen = _chosen_anchors(_anchor_events(pages))
    out = []
    for i, (name, page) in enumerate(pages):

        def _sub(m: re.Match[str], i: int = i) -> str:
            n = m.group(2)
            if (i, m.start()) in chosen:
                return f"Hlasování číslo {n}"
            return f"(odkaz na hlasování {n})"

        out.append((name, _VOTE_LINK_RE.sub(_sub, page)))
    return out

def sitting_text(pages: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> tuple[str, dict[int, dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Plain text of a sitting and where each vote is announced in it.

    Args:
        pages: ``(page name, html)`` in page order.

    Returns:
        ``(text, {id_hlasovani: {"cislo", "page", "start", "end"}})``; ``text[start:end]``
        is everything since the previous vote's announcement.
    """
    events = _anchor_events(pages)
    chosen = _chosen_anchors(events)
    parts: list[str] = []
    size = 0
    last_end = 0
    out: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    by_page: dict[int, list[re.Match[str]]] = {}
    for i, m, _ in events:
        if (i, m.start()) in chosen:
            by_page.setdefault(i, []).append(m)
    for i, (name, page) in enumerate(pages):
        pos = 0
        for m in by_page.get(i, []):
            seg = _plain(page[pos : m.start()])
            parts.append(seg)
            size += len(seg) + 1
            vid = int(m.group(1))
            out[vid] = {"cislo": int(m.group(2)), "page": name, "start": last_end, "end": size}
            last_end, pos = size, m.end()
        seg = _plain(page[pos:])
        parts.append(seg)
        size += len(seg) + 1
    return " ".join(parts), out

def vote_kind(window: str) -> str:
    """Rule-based kind of a vote from its lead-in text (``other`` if none matches)."""
    best, best_pos = "other", -1
    for kind, pattern in _KIND_PATTERNS.items():
        hits = [m.end() for m in pattern.finditer(window)]
        if hits and hits[-1] > best_pos:
            best, best_pos = kind, hits[-1]
    return best

def earlier_proposals(text: str, start: int, tail: str, hint: str = "") -> list[str]:
    """Earlier proposals in the sitting a referential lead-in may point at.

    Args:
        text: Plain text of the sitting.
        start: Where the vote's lead-in tail starts (proposals are searched before it).
        tail: The lead-in tail.
        hint: Extra text whose words also rank the proposals (the previous vote's lead-in
            when this one is bare: "druhý návrh … řečnická doba").

    Returns:
        Up to ``MAX_SNIPPETS`` snippets ``"<speaker>: <text>"`` in chronological order.
    """
    lo = max(0, start - HISTORY_CHARS)
    tail_speaker = speaker_before(text, start + len(tail))
    cands: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []
    last = -SNIPPET_CHARS
    for m in _PROPOSAL_RE.finditer(text, lo, start):
        if m.start() - last < SNIPPET_CHARS:
            continue
        last = m.start()
        snippet = text[max(lo, m.start() - 80) : min(start, m.start() + SNIPPET_CHARS)]
        speaker = speaker_before(text, m.start())
        cands.append(
            (
                _score(snippet, speaker, hint[-1500:] + " " + tail, tail_speaker),
                m.start(),
                f"{speaker}: {snippet}",
            )
        )
    best = sorted(cands, key=lambda c: (c[0], c[1]), reverse=True)[:MAX_SNIPPETS]
    return [s for score, _, s in sorted(best, key=lambda c: c[1]) if score > 0]

Mark challenged votes invalid and link them, and chair-repeated votes, to the repeat.

def link_repeats(records: dict[str, dict], votes: pl.DataFrame, text: str, spans: dict) -> None:
    """Mark challenged votes invalid and link them, and chair-repeated votes, to the repeat.

    Args:
        records: Sitting records keyed by ``str(id_hlasovani)`` (updated in place).
        votes: The sitting's ``hl_hlasovani`` rows.
        text: Plain steno text of the sitting.
        spans: ``sitting_text`` vote spans.
    """
    by_cislo = dict(zip(votes["cislo"].to_list(), votes["id_hlasovani"].to_list(), strict=True))
    result = dict(zip(votes["id_hlasovani"].to_list(), votes["vysledek"].to_list(), strict=True))
    for vid, rec in records.items():
        span = spans.get(int(vid))
        if not span:
            continue
        window = text[max(span["start"], span["end"] - WINDOW_CHARS) : span["end"]]
        cislo = rec["cislo"]
        repeat = by_cislo.get(cislo + 1)
        if rec.get("subkind") == "challenge" or rule_kind(window)[1] == "challenge":
            target = by_cislo.get(referenced_vote(window) or cislo - 1)
            if result.get(int(vid)) == "A" and target and repeat and str(target) in records:
                records[str(target)].update(invalid_by=int(vid), repeated_as=repeat)
                if str(repeat) in records:
                    records[str(repeat)]["repeats"] = target
                    _inherit_subject(records[str(target)], records[str(repeat)])
        elif chair_declared_void(window) and repeat:
            rec["chair_repeated_as"] = repeat
            if str(repeat) in records:
                records[str(repeat)]["repeats"] = int(vid)

def anchor_check(votes: pl.DataFrame, anchored: set[int]) -> dict[str, dict[str, int]]:
    """Agenda items whose anchored vote count differs from ``hl_hlasovani``.

    Args:
        votes: The sitting's ``hl_hlasovani`` rows.
        anchored: Vote ids anchored in the steno.

    Returns:
        ``{str(bod): {"votes": n, "anchored": m}}`` for mismatching items only.
    """
    out: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    for bod, ids in votes.group_by("bod").agg("id_hlasovani").iter_rows():
        n_anchored = sum(i in anchored for i in ids)
        if n_anchored != len(ids):
            out[str(bod)] = {"votes": len(ids), "anchored": n_anchored}
    return out

Source code in pspcz_analyzer/services/vote_steno_text.py 
def clean_proposer(names: str, context: str) -> str:
    """Proposer names reduced to the words found in the steno text.

    Titles ("pan poslanec") are dropped, and so is a name whose surname is not in the
    text; a first name the model added is dropped on its own.
    """
    low = " ".join(context.lower().split())
    kept = []
    for name in re.split(r",| a ", names):
        words = [w for w in name.split() if w[:1].isupper() and len(w) >= 3]
        if not words or not name.split() or words[-1] != name.split()[-1]:
            continue
        surname = words[-1]
        if surname[:-1].lower() not in low:
            continue
        # a first name counts only right before the surname ("Marek Benda"), else it is invented
        full = " ".join(words).lower()
        kept.append(" ".join(words) if full[:-1] in low else surname)
    return ", ".join(kept)

def quote_speaker(text: str, end: int, quote: str) -> str:
    """Who proposed it, when the quote is the speaker's own proposal ("navrhuji, aby …").

    Args:
        text: Plain text of the sitting.
        end: Where the vote is announced (the quote is searched before it).
        quote: Verbatim quote of the record.

    Returns:
        The speaker's name, or "" when the quote is not a first-person proposal or not found.
    """
    if not quote or not _OWN_PROPOSAL_RE.search(quote):
        return ""
    head = " ".join(quote.split())[:60].lower()
    lo = max(0, end - HISTORY_CHARS)
    pos = text[lo:end].lower().rfind(head)  # the model may change the first letter's case
    return speaker_before(text, lo + pos) if pos >= 0 else ""

def quote_named(proposer: str, quote: str) -> str:
    """Add proposers the chair names in the quote ("navrhl pan poslanec Baxa a přidal se …").

    Args:
        proposer: The proposer found so far (names joined by ", ").
        quote: Verbatim quote of the record.

    Returns:
        The named proposers when they include every surname of ``proposer`` and add one,
        else ``proposer`` unchanged.
    """
    if not quote or not _NAMED_PROPOSAL_RE.search(quote):
        return proposer
    named = list(dict.fromkeys(m.group(1) for m in _TITLED_NAME_RE.finditer(quote)))
    have = {n.split()[-1] for n in proposer.split(", ") if n}
    if len(named) > len(have) and have <= {n.split()[-1] for n in named}:
        return ", ".join(named)
    return proposer

def list_votes(
    data: PeriodData,
    search: str = "",
    page: int = 1,
    per_page: int = 12,
    outcome_filter: str = "",
    topic_filter: str = "",
    lang: str = "cs",
    kind_filter: str = "",
) -> dict:
    """List votes grouped by agenda item, with filters and pagination by group (#113).

    Void votes stay in the list (marked ``is_void``) so readers see them.

    Args:
        data: Period data.
        search: Free-text search over the agenda item names.
        page: 1-based page of groups.
        per_page: Groups per page.
        outcome_filter: "A" (passed) or "R" (rejected), empty for all.
        topic_filter: Topic label of the linked tisk, empty for all.
        lang: Language code for topic labels ('cs' or 'en').
        kind_filter: "final" or "amendment" (kinds known from amendment data).

    Returns:
        Dict with groups, rows (flat rows of the page), total (votes),
        total_groups, page, per_page, total_pages.
    """
    votes = _apply_vote_filters(data.votes, data, search, outcome_filter, topic_filter)
    votes = filter_kind(votes, data, kind_filter).sort("id_hlasovani", descending=True)
    keys = votes.select("schuze", "bod", "datum").unique(maintain_order=True)

    total_groups = keys.height
    total_pages = max(1, (total_groups + per_page - 1) // per_page)
    page = max(1, min(page, total_pages))
    page_keys = keys.slice((page - 1) * per_page, per_page)
    page_rows = votes.join(
        page_keys, on=["schuze", "bod", "datum"], how="semi", maintain_order="left"
    )

    void_ids = set(data.void_votes.get_column("id_hlasovani").to_list())
    rows = page_rows.select(
        "id_hlasovani",
        "datum",
        "cas",
        "schuze",
        "cislo",
        "bod",
        "nazev_dlouhy",
        "nazev_kratky",
        "vysledek",
        "pro",
        "proti",
        "zdrzel",
        "nehlasoval",
        "prihlaseno",
        "kvorum",
    ).to_dicts()
    _enrich_vote_rows(rows, data, lang)
    for row in rows:
        row["is_void"] = row["id_hlasovani"] in void_ids
        row["kind"] = kind_on_item(vote_kind(data, row["id_hlasovani"]), row.get("tisk_ct"))
        row["steno"] = vote_question(data, row["id_hlasovani"], lang)

    groups = _group_rows(rows)
    for g in groups:
        g["reading"] = reading_at(data, g["tisk_ct"], g["schuze"])
    return {
        "groups": groups,
        "rows": rows,
        "total": votes.height,
        "total_groups": total_groups,
        "page": page,
        "per_page": per_page,
        "total_pages": total_pages,
    }

def vote_detail(data: PeriodData, vote_id: int, lang: str = "cs") -> dict | None:
    """Get full detail for a single vote: metadata + per-party + per-MP breakdown."""
    vote_row = data.votes.filter(pl.col("id_hlasovani") == vote_id)

def start_period(
    self,
    period: int,
    period_data: PeriodData,
    on_complete: Callable | None = None,
    on_progress: Callable[[int, list[BillAmendmentData]], None] | None = None,
    mode: AmendmentMode = AmendmentMode.FULL,
    refresh_active: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Start the amendment pipeline for a single period.

    Args:
        period: Electoral period number.
        period_data: Loaded period data with tisk_lookup populated.
        on_complete: Optional callback(period, bills) on completion.
        on_progress: Optional callback(period, bills) for incremental UI refresh.
        mode: Pipeline execution mode.
        refresh_active: When True, re-scrape active bills' histories so newly
            third-read bills are picked up (daily refresh).
    """
    if period in self._tasks and not self._tasks[period].done():
        logger.info("[amendment pipeline] Already running for period {}", period)
        return

    prog = AmendmentProgress(status=AmendmentStatus.RUNNING)
    self._progress[period] = prog
    flag = CancellationFlag(period)
    self._flags[period] = flag

    async def _run() -> None:
        try:
            bills = await asyncio.to_thread(
                _run_pipeline_sync,
                period,
                period_data,
                self.cache_dir,
                prog,
                on_progress,
                mode,
                refresh_active,
                flag.check,
            )
            prog.status = AmendmentStatus.COMPLETED
            prog.stage = AmendmentStage.COMPLETED
            if on_complete:
                on_complete(period, bills)
        except PipelineCancelled:
            prog.status = AmendmentStatus.CANCELLED
            logger.info("[amendment pipeline] Cancelled for period {}", period)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            prog.status = AmendmentStatus.CANCELLED
            logger.info("[amendment pipeline] Cancelled for period {}", period)
            raise
        except LLMUnavailable as exc:
            prog.status = AmendmentStatus.FAILED
            prog.stage = AmendmentStage.FAILED
            logger.error(
                "[amendment pipeline] Period {} stopped, LLM unavailable: {}", period, exc
            )
            raise
        except Exception:
            prog.status = AmendmentStatus.FAILED
            prog.stage = AmendmentStage.FAILED
            logger.opt(exception=True).error(
                "[amendment pipeline] Failed for period {}", period
            )
        finally:
            self._flags.pop(period, None)

    task = asyncio.create_task(_run())
    task.add_done_callback(lambda t: self._on_task_done(period, t))
    self._tasks[period] = task

def cancel_period(self, period: int) -> bool:
    """Cancel the amendment pipeline for a single period.

    Flips the period's cancellation flag; the worker thread stops
    cooperatively at its next checkpoint. (task.cancel() alone cannot
    interrupt work running inside asyncio.to_thread – it only
    releases the awaiting coroutine.)

    Returns True if a cancellation was requested.
    """
    flag = self._flags.get(period)
    if flag is None or not self.is_running(period):
        return False
    flag.cancel()
    logger.info("[amendment pipeline] Cancellation requested for period {}", period)
    return True

    """Request cancellation of all running amendment pipelines.

async def wait_stopped(self, timeout: float = 10.0) -> None:
    """Wait for running tasks to drain after cancel_all().

    Tasks still running after *timeout* are hard-cancelled – that
    releases the event-loop side immediately; worker threads exit
    at their next cancellation checkpoint.
    """
    tasks = [t for t in self._tasks.values() if not t.done()]
    if tasks:
        _, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=timeout)
        if pending:
            logger.warning(
                "[amendment pipeline] {} tasks still draining after {}s – forcing cancellation",
                len(pending),
                timeout,
            )
            for t in pending:
                t.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
    self._tasks.clear()
    self._flags.clear()

def load_amendments(
    cache_dir: Path,
    period: int,
) -> dict[tuple[int, int], BillAmendmentData]:
    """Load amendment data from parquet cache.

    Args:
        cache_dir: Base cache directory.
        period: Electoral period number.

    Returns:
        Dict mapping (schuze, bod) to BillAmendmentData.
    """
    path = _cache_path(cache_dir, period)
    if not path.exists():
        return {}

    df = pl.read_parquet(path)

def parse_steno_amendments(
    html: str,
    period: int = 0,
    schuze: int = 0,
    bod: int = 0,
) -> tuple[list[AmendmentVote], float, list[str]]:
    """Parse a stenographic record HTML page for amendment votes.

    Args:
        html: Raw HTML of the stenographic record page.
        period: Electoral period (for logging).
        schuze: Session number (for logging).
        bod: Agenda item number (for logging).

    Returns:
        Tuple of (amendments, confidence, warnings).
    """
    warnings: list[str] = []
    confidence = 1.0

    # Clean HTML
    text = _clean_html(html)

    # Narrow to the voting section. A missing start marker is no longer fatal:
    # _extract_section falls back to the full text and we lower confidence.
    marker = _START_RE.search(text)
    if not marker:
        warnings.append("No explicit amendment-voting start marker; parsed full bod text")
        confidence -= 0.1
    elif _count_votes(text) > _count_votes(text[marker.start() :]):
        # Marker present but votes also precede it → multi-day voting.
        warnings.append("Multi-day voting detected; parsed full bod text")
        confidence -= 0.05
    section = _extract_section(text)

    # Split into blocks – no vote-numbered blocks means genuinely no votes here.
    raw_blocks = _split_into_blocks(section)
    if not raw_blocks:
        warnings.append("No vote blocks found in steno text")
        confidence -= 0.2
        logger.debug(
            "No vote blocks found in steno for period={} schuze={} bod={}",
            period,
            schuze,
            bod,
        )
        return [], max(0.0, confidence), warnings

    # Parse each block
    parsed_blocks = [_parse_block(b) for b in raw_blocks]

    # Count blocks without vote numbers (unmatched)
    unmatched = sum(1 for b in parsed_blocks if b.vote_number is None and not b.is_withdrawal)
    if unmatched > 0:
        confidence -= 0.1 * min(unmatched, 3)
        warnings.append(f"{unmatched} block(s) without vote numbers")

    # Count blocks without letter designations
    no_letter = sum(
        1
        for b in parsed_blocks
        if not b.letter and b.vote_number is not None and not b.is_final and not b.is_procedure
    )
    if no_letter > 0:
        confidence -= 0.05 * min(no_letter, 3)
        warnings.append(f"{no_letter} vote(s) without amendment letter")

    # Convert to amendments
    amendments = _blocks_to_amendments(parsed_blocks)
    amendments += _unvotable_letters(section, amendments)

    confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, confidence))

    logger.debug(
        "Parsed {} amendments from steno period={} schuze={} bod={} (confidence={:.2f})",
        len(amendments),
        period,
        schuze,
        bod,
        confidence,
    )

    return amendments, confidence, warnings

def parse_amendment_pdf(text: str) -> list[PdfAmendment]:
    """Parse extracted amendment PDF text into structured amendments.

    Splits by top-level letter headers (A., B., C., ...) of MPs and committees
    and extracts submitter names and sub-amendment text for each.

    Args:
        text: Raw text extracted from the amendment PDF.

    Returns:
        List of PdfAmendment, one per letter. Returns empty list if
        the text has no parseable structure.
    """
    if not text or not text.strip():
        return []

    headers = _letter_headers(text)

    # Fallback to alternative format without title prefix
    if not headers:
        matches = list(_LETTER_HEADER_ALT_RE.finditer(text))
        if matches:
            return _parse_with_alt_headers(text, matches)
        logger.debug("No amendment letter headers found in PDF text ({} chars)", len(text))
        return []

    amendments: list[PdfAmendment] = []

    for i, (start, end, letter, names, title) in enumerate(headers):
        # Section runs from end of header line to start of next header (or end)
        section_end = headers[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(headers) else len(text)
        section_text = text[end:section_end]
        raw_text = text[start:section_end].strip()

        amendments.append(
            PdfAmendment(
                letter=letter,
                submitter_names=names,
                submitter_titles=[title],
                sub_amendments=_parse_sub_amendments(letter, section_text),
                raw_text=raw_text,
            )
        )

    logger.debug(
        "Parsed {} amendment letters from PDF ({} chars)",
        len(amendments),
        len(text),
    )
    return amendments

def pending_cts(period_data: PeriodData, voted_cts: set[int]) -> dict[int, str]:
    """Bills with a published amendment document and no 3rd reading yet.

    Args:
        period_data: Period data with tisk histories loaded.
        voted_cts: Tisk numbers that already have 3rd-reading votes.

    Returns:
        ``{ct: title}``.
    """
    out: dict[int, str] = {}
    for tisk in period_data.tisk_lookup.values():
        history = tisk.history
        if (
            tisk.ct in voted_cts
            or tisk.id_druh not in BILL_DRUHY
            or history is None
            or history.amendment_tisk_ct1 is None
            or history.current_status in TERMINAL_TISK_STATUSES
            or any(s.stage_type == "3_cteni" for s in history.stages)
        ):
            continue
        out[tisk.ct] = tisk.nazev
    return out

def build_pending_bills(
    period: int,
    pending: dict[int, str],
    pdf_data: dict[int, list[PdfAmendment]],
    period_data: PeriodData,
) -> list[BillAmendmentData]:
    """One unvoted entry per pending bill whose document parsed into letters.

    Args:
        period: Electoral period.
        pending: Output of pending_cts.
        pdf_data: ``ct -> parsed letters`` from the amendment PDF stage.
        period_data: Period data (for the amendment sub-tisk ids).

    Returns:
        Bills keyed ``(PENDING_SCHUZE, ct)``; bills without parsed letters are skipped.
    """
    histories = {t.ct: t.history for t in period_data.tisk_lookup.values() if t.history}
    bills: list[BillAmendmentData] = []
    for ct, title in sorted(pending.items()):
        letters = pdf_data.get(ct) or []
        if not letters:
            continue
        history = histories.get(ct)
        bills.append(
            BillAmendmentData(
                period=period,
                schuze=PENDING_SCHUZE,
                bod=ct,
                ct=ct,
                tisk_nazev=title,
                amendments=[_unvoted(a) for a in letters],
                amendment_tisk_ct1=history.amendment_tisk_ct1 if history else None,
                amendment_tisk_idd=history.amendment_tisk_idd if history else None,
            )
        )
    logger.info(
        "[amendment pipeline] Pending bills: {}/{} with parsed letters",
        len(bills),
        len(pending),
    )
    return bills

def start_period(
    self,
    period: int,
    period_data: PeriodData,
    on_complete: Callable | None = None,
    on_progress: Callable[[int, list[BillAmendmentData]], None] | None = None,
    mode: AmendmentMode = AmendmentMode.FULL,
    refresh_active: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Start the amendment pipeline for a single period.

    Args:
        period: Electoral period number.
        period_data: Loaded period data with tisk_lookup populated.
        on_complete: Optional callback(period, bills) on completion.
        on_progress: Optional callback(period, bills) for incremental UI refresh.
        mode: Pipeline execution mode.
        refresh_active: When True, re-scrape active bills' histories so newly
            third-read bills are picked up (daily refresh).
    """
    if period in self._tasks and not self._tasks[period].done():
        logger.info("[amendment pipeline] Already running for period {}", period)
        return

    prog = AmendmentProgress(status=AmendmentStatus.RUNNING)
    self._progress[period] = prog
    flag = CancellationFlag(period)
    self._flags[period] = flag

    async def _run() -> None:
        try:
            bills = await asyncio.to_thread(
                _run_pipeline_sync,
                period,
                period_data,
                self.cache_dir,
                prog,
                on_progress,
                mode,
                refresh_active,
                flag.check,
            )
            prog.status = AmendmentStatus.COMPLETED
            prog.stage = AmendmentStage.COMPLETED
            if on_complete:
                on_complete(period, bills)
        except PipelineCancelled:
            prog.status = AmendmentStatus.CANCELLED
            logger.info("[amendment pipeline] Cancelled for period {}", period)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            prog.status = AmendmentStatus.CANCELLED
            logger.info("[amendment pipeline] Cancelled for period {}", period)
            raise
        except LLMUnavailable as exc:
            prog.status = AmendmentStatus.FAILED
            prog.stage = AmendmentStage.FAILED
            logger.error(
                "[amendment pipeline] Period {} stopped, LLM unavailable: {}", period, exc
            )
            raise
        except Exception:
            prog.status = AmendmentStatus.FAILED
            prog.stage = AmendmentStage.FAILED
            logger.opt(exception=True).error(
                "[amendment pipeline] Failed for period {}", period
            )
        finally:
            self._flags.pop(period, None)

    task = asyncio.create_task(_run())
    task.add_done_callback(lambda t: self._on_task_done(period, t))
    self._tasks[period] = task

def cancel_period(self, period: int) -> bool:
    """Cancel the amendment pipeline for a single period.

    Flips the period's cancellation flag; the worker thread stops
    cooperatively at its next checkpoint. (task.cancel() alone cannot
    interrupt work running inside asyncio.to_thread – it only
    releases the awaiting coroutine.)

    Returns True if a cancellation was requested.
    """
    flag = self._flags.get(period)
    if flag is None or not self.is_running(period):
        return False
    flag.cancel()
    logger.info("[amendment pipeline] Cancellation requested for period {}", period)
    return True

def cancel_all(self) -> None:
    """Request cancellation of all running amendment pipelines.

    Flips every period flag; running stages stop cooperatively at
    their next checkpoint. Await wait_stopped() to let tasks drain.
    """
    for flag in self._flags.values():
        flag.cancel()
    logger.info("[amendment pipeline] Cancellation requested for all periods")

docs.title: wait_stopped(timeout=10.0) async
docs.text:
Wait for running tasks to drain after cancel_all().

Tasks still running after timeout are hard-cancelled – that releases the event-loop side immediately; worker threads exit at their next cancellation checkpoint.

Source code in pspcz_analyzer/services/amendments/pipeline.py 
async def wait_stopped(self, timeout: float = 10.0) -> None:
    """Wait for running tasks to drain after cancel_all().

    Tasks still running after *timeout* are hard-cancelled – that
    releases the event-loop side immediately; worker threads exit
    at their next cancellation checkpoint.
    """
    tasks = [t for t in self._tasks.values() if not t.done()]
    if tasks:
        _, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=timeout)
        if pending:
            logger.warning(
                "[amendment pipeline] {} tasks still draining after {}s – forcing cancellation",
                len(pending),
                timeout,
            )
            for t in pending:
                t.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
    self._tasks.clear()
    self._flags.clear()

def parse_steno_amendments(
    html: str,
    period: int = 0,
    schuze: int = 0,
    bod: int = 0,
) -> tuple[list[AmendmentVote], float, list[str]]:
    """Parse a stenographic record HTML page for amendment votes.

    Args:
        html: Raw HTML of the stenographic record page.
        period: Electoral period (for logging).
        schuze: Session number (for logging).
        bod: Agenda item number (for logging).

    Returns:
        Tuple of (amendments, confidence, warnings).
    """
    warnings: list[str] = []
    confidence = 1.0

    # Clean HTML
    text = _clean_html(html)

    # Narrow to the voting section. A missing start marker is no longer fatal:
    # _extract_section falls back to the full text and we lower confidence.
    marker = _START_RE.search(text)
    if not marker:
        warnings.append("No explicit amendment-voting start marker; parsed full bod text")
        confidence -= 0.1
    elif _count_votes(text) > _count_votes(text[marker.start() :]):
        # Marker present but votes also precede it → multi-day voting.
        warnings.append("Multi-day voting detected; parsed full bod text")
        confidence -= 0.05
    section = _extract_section(text)

    # Split into blocks – no vote-numbered blocks means genuinely no votes here.
    raw_blocks = _split_into_blocks(section)
    if not raw_blocks:
        warnings.append("No vote blocks found in steno text")
        confidence -= 0.2
        logger.debug(
            "No vote blocks found in steno for period={} schuze={} bod={}",
            period,
            schuze,
            bod,
        )
        return [], max(0.0, confidence), warnings

    # Parse each block
    parsed_blocks = [_parse_block(b) for b in raw_blocks]

    # Count blocks without vote numbers (unmatched)
    unmatched = sum(1 for b in parsed_blocks if b.vote_number is None and not b.is_withdrawal)
    if unmatched > 0:
        confidence -= 0.1 * min(unmatched, 3)
        warnings.append(f"{unmatched} block(s) without vote numbers")

    # Count blocks without letter designations
    no_letter = sum(
        1
        for b in parsed_blocks
        if not b.letter and b.vote_number is not None and not b.is_final and not b.is_procedure
    )
    if no_letter > 0:
        confidence -= 0.05 * min(no_letter, 3)
        warnings.append(f"{no_letter} vote(s) without amendment letter")

    # Convert to amendments
    amendments = _blocks_to_amendments(parsed_blocks)
    amendments += _unvotable_letters(section, amendments)

    confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, confidence))

    logger.debug(
        "Parsed {} amendments from steno period={} schuze={} bod={} (confidence={:.2f})",
        len(amendments),
        period,
        schuze,
        bod,
        confidence,
    )

    return amendments, confidence, warnings

def cross_validate_amendments(
    amendments: list[AmendmentVote],
    schuze_votes: pl.DataFrame,
    schuze: int,
    bod: int,
) -> tuple[list[AmendmentVote], list[str]]:
    """Cross-validate parser output against official vote data.

    Uses the nazev_dlouhy column from official votes to:
    1. Fill missing letters on AmendmentVote objects
    2. Detect missed amendments and create minimal entries
    3. Detect final votes from title
    4. Skip procedure votes

    Args:
        amendments: List of parsed AmendmentVote objects.
        schuze_votes: Votes DataFrame filtered to this schuze.
        schuze: Session number (for logging).
        bod: Agenda item number (for logging).

    Returns:
        Tuple of (corrected amendments, list of warning messages).
    """
    warnings: list[str] = []

    # Build vote_number → title mapping from official data
    vote_titles: dict[int, str] = {}
    if "cislo" in schuze_votes.columns and "nazev_dlouhy" in schuze_votes.columns:
        for row in schuze_votes.iter_rows(named=True):
            cislo = row.get("cislo")
            title = row.get("nazev_dlouhy") or ""
            if cislo is not None:
                vote_titles[int(cislo)] = title

    # Build vote_number → amendment index for quick lookups
    amend_by_vote: dict[int, int] = {}
    for i, a in enumerate(amendments):
        if a.vote_number and a.vote_number > 0:
            amend_by_vote[a.vote_number] = i

    # Pass 1: fill missing letters and detect final votes
    for a in amendments:
        title = vote_titles.get(a.vote_number, "")
        if not title:
            continue

        # Fill missing letter from vote title
        if not a.letter and not a.is_final_vote:
            extracted = _extract_letter_from_vote_title(title)
            if extracted:
                a.letter = extracted
                a.match_source = "vote_title"  # psp.cz's vote title names it, not the steno
                warnings.append(
                    f"Filled letter '{extracted}' from vote title "
                    f"(vote {a.vote_number}, schuze={schuze}, bod={bod})"
                )

        # Detect final vote from title
        if not a.is_final_vote and _VOTE_TITLE_FINAL_RE.search(title):
            a.is_final_vote = True
            warnings.append(f"Detected final vote from title (vote {a.vote_number})")

    # Pass 2: detect missed amendments (official votes with letters not in parser output)
    known_vote_numbers = {a.vote_number for a in amendments if a.vote_number}
    for cislo, title in vote_titles.items():
        if cislo in known_vote_numbers:
            continue

        # Skip procedure votes
        if _VOTE_TITLE_PROCEDURE_RE.search(title):
            continue

        # Check for final vote
        if _VOTE_TITLE_FINAL_RE.search(title):
            continue

        # Check for amendment letter
        letter = _extract_letter_from_vote_title(title)
        if letter:
            amendments.append(
                AmendmentVote(
                    letter=letter,
                    vote_number=cislo,
                    result="",
                )
            )
            warnings.append(
                f"Created missing amendment '{letter}' from official vote "
                f"{cislo} (schuze={schuze}, bod={bod})"
            )

    return amendments, warnings

docs.title: steno_scraper
docs.text:
Download and cache stenographic record HTML pages from psp.cz.

The steno structure for each session (schůze) has three levels: 1. Index page: .../{NNN}schuz/index.htm – lists all agenda items (bods) with anchors like and links to day-pages (e.g. 45-3.html#q230). 2. Day-pages: .../{NNN}schuz/45-3.html – TOC for one day of the session, listing speakers with links to individual transcript sub-pages. 3. Sub-pages: .../{NNN}schuz/s045062.htm – actual speech transcript text.

The amendment voting text (e.g. "přikročíme k hlasování o pozměňovacích návrzích") lives in the sub-pages, so we must follow all three levels.

This module handles: - Parsing session index pages to find which day-pages discuss a given bod - Extracting steno sub-page links from day-pages - Downloading and caching all pages

def find_steno_for_bod(
    period: int,
    schuze: int,
    bod: int,
    cache_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[str | None, str, StenoFailure | None]:
    """Find and download steno transcript pages for a specific agenda item.

    Follows the three-level psp.cz steno structure (index → day-pages →
    transcript sub-pages) and returns the concatenated transcript for the bod.
    Rather than guessing where amendment voting starts from a narrative phrase,
    it captures the bod's whole span and lets the parser + cross-validation
    against the official vote numbers isolate the amendment votes.

    Args:
        period: Electoral period number.
        schuze: Session number.
        bod: Agenda item number.
        cache_dir: Base cache directory.

    Returns:
        Tuple of (concatenated transcript HTML or None, first sub-page URL,
        StenoFailure reason or None on success).
    """
    year = PERIOD_YEARS.get(period, "")
    if not year:
        logger.warning("[amendment pipeline] No year mapping for period {}", period)
        return None, "", StenoFailure.NO_YEAR_MAPPING

    base_url = PSP_STENO_BASE_TEMPLATE.format(year=year, session=schuze)

    index_html = _download_index(period, schuze, cache_dir)
    if not index_html:
        return None, "", StenoFailure.INDEX_DOWNLOAD_FAILED

    all_subpages = _collect_bod_subpages(index_html, base_url, period, schuze, bod, cache_dir)
    if all_subpages is None:
        return None, "", StenoFailure.BOD_NOT_IN_INDEX
    if not all_subpages:
        logger.debug(
            "[amendment pipeline] No steno sub-pages found for period={} schuze={} bod={}",
            period,
            schuze,
            bod,
        )
        return None, "", StenoFailure.NO_SUBPAGES

    if len(all_subpages) > STENO_MAX_SUBPAGES_PER_BOD:
        logger.warning(
            "[amendment pipeline] Bod {} has {} steno sub-pages (period={} schuze={}); "
            "keeping last {} (voting is at the end)",
            bod,
            len(all_subpages),
            period,
            schuze,
            STENO_MAX_SUBPAGES_PER_BOD,
        )
        all_subpages = all_subpages[-STENO_MAX_SUBPAGES_PER_BOD:]

    logger.debug(
        "[amendment pipeline] Found {} steno sub-pages for period={} schuze={} bod={}",
        len(all_subpages),
        period,
        schuze,
        bod,
    )

    collected = _download_all_subpages(base_url, all_subpages, period, schuze, cache_dir)
    if not collected:
        return None, "", StenoFailure.SUBPAGE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED

    first_url = base_url + collected[0][0]
    # same vote anchoring as vote_steno (#102 item 7): announcements read "Hlasování číslo N"
    combined_parts = [html for _, html in normalize_vote_anchors(collected)]
    return "\n".join(combined_parts), first_url, None

docs.text:
Resolve submitter names to MP IDs and party affiliations.

Uses pdf_submitter_names (nominative case, high-confidence match) when present, otherwise the steno submitter_names (inflected, fuzzy matched). Resolves all names of the chosen source, not just the first match.

Mutates AmendmentVote objects in-place, populating submitter_ids and submitter_parties fields.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default bills list[BillAmendmentData]

List of bill amendment data with parsed submitter_names.

required mp_info DataFrame

DataFrame with id_poslanec, prijmeni, party columns.

required mp_votes DataFrame | None

Per-vote MP rows with the club on the vote day (add_vote_parties); the club is taken on the day of the letter's vote (#101/#103).

None Source code in pspcz_analyzer/services/amendments/submitter_resolver.py 
def resolve_submitter_ids(
    bills: list[BillAmendmentData],
    mp_info: pl.DataFrame,
    mp_votes: pl.DataFrame | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Resolve submitter names to MP IDs and party affiliations.

    Uses pdf_submitter_names (nominative case, high-confidence match) when
    present, otherwise the steno submitter_names (inflected, fuzzy matched).
    Resolves all names of the chosen source, not just the first match.

    Mutates AmendmentVote objects in-place, populating submitter_ids
    and submitter_parties fields.

    Args:
        bills: List of bill amendment data with parsed submitter_names.
        mp_info: DataFrame with id_poslanec, prijmeni, party columns.
        mp_votes: Per-vote MP rows with the club on the vote day (``add_vote_parties``);
            the club is taken on the day of the letter's vote (#101/#103).
    """
    mp_rows = mp_info.to_dicts()
    # shortcut: the club on the 3rd-reading vote day stands in for the filing day (days
    # apart); use the filing date if a club switch in between ever matters
    at_vote = _clubs_at_votes(bills, mp_votes)
    resolved_count = 0

    for bill in bills:
        all_amends = list(bill.amendments)
        if bill.final_vote:
            all_amends.append(bill.final_vote)

        for amend in all_amends:
            # PDF names (nominative, from the consolidated document) are
            # authoritative; inflected steno names only when the PDF has none,
            # since fuzzy-matching both gave one submitter two clubs ("napříč").
            candidate_names = list(amend.pdf_submitter_names or amend.submitter_names)
            for name in candidate_names:
                if "výbor" in name.lower():  # committee letter, not an MP
                    continue
                result = _match_name_to_mp(name, mp_rows)
                if result is not None:
                    mp_id, party = result
                    party = at_vote.get((amend.id_hlasovani, mp_id)) or party
                    if mp_id not in amend.submitter_ids:  # deduplicate
                        amend.submitter_ids.append(mp_id)
                        amend.submitter_parties.append(party)
                        resolved_count += 1

    logger.info(
        "[amendment pipeline] Resolved {} submitter names to MP IDs",
        resolved_count,
    )

def carry_summaries(
    bills: list[BillAmendmentData], previous: dict[tuple[int, int], BillAmendmentData]
) -> int:
    """Copy summaries from the previous run onto letters whose text did not change.

    A rerun then only sends new or changed letters to the LLM.

    Args:
        bills: Freshly parsed bills (updated in place).
        previous: Bills of the previous run keyed by ``(schuze, bod)``.

    Returns:
        Number of letters that kept their summary.
    """
    kept = 0
    for bill in bills:
        old = previous.get((bill.schuze, bill.bod))
        if not old:
            continue
        by_letter = {(a.letter, a.amendment_text): a for a in old.amendments if a.summary}
        for amend in bill.amendments:
            prev = by_letter.get((amend.letter, amend.amendment_text))
            if prev and amend.letter and amend.amendment_text:
                amend.summary, amend.summary_en = prev.summary, prev.summary_en
                amend.summary_warning = prev.summary_warning
                kept += 1
    logger.info("[amendment pipeline] kept {} letter summaries from the previous run", kept)
    return kept

    self,
    *,
    provider: str,

def is_available(self) -> bool:
    """Check that the model answers a tiny test completion. Caches after first call."""
    if self._available is not None:
        return self._available

    match self.provider:
        case "ollama":
            reachable = self._check_ollama_availability()
        case "openai":
            reachable = True
        case _:
            reachable = False
    compat = self.provider == "openai" or self._openai_compat
    self._available = reachable and probe_completion(
        self.base_url, self._headers, self.model, compat
    )
    if not self._available:
        logger.warning(
            "{} Not available at {} ({})", self._log_prefix, self.base_url, self.model
        )
    return self._available

def summarize_amendments(
    self,
    text: str,
    title: str,
    amendments: list[dict[str, str]],
    *,
    lang: str = "cs",
    bill_context: str = "",
    _truncated: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Generate per-amendment summaries for a bill in a single LLM call.

    Args:
        text: Combined amendment PDF text.
        title: Bill title.
        amendments: List of dicts with 'letter', 'submitter', 'description'.
        lang: Language code ('cs' or 'en').
        bill_context: Optional AI-generated summary of the original bill
            for additional context in prompts.
        _truncated: If True, skip truncation.

    Returns:
        Dict mapping amendment letter to summary text.
    """
    truncated = text if _truncated else truncate_legislative_text(text)
    sanitized_title = _sanitize_llm_input(
        title or ("(bez názvu)" if lang == "cs" else "(no title)")
    )
    sanitized_text = _sanitize_llm_input(truncated)
    amendments_list = _format_amendments_list(amendments)

    amendments_with_text = sum(1 for a in amendments if a.get("amendment_text"))
    logger.debug(
        "{} summarize_amendments({}): {}/{} amendments have per-amendment text",
        self._log_prefix,
        lang,
        amendments_with_text,
        len(amendments),
    )

    if bill_context:
        if lang == "cs":
            bill_context_section = (
                f"Kontext návrhu zákona (AI shrnutí původního tisku):\n{bill_context}\n\n"
            )
        else:
            bill_context_section = (
                f"Bill context (AI-generated summary of the original bill):\n{bill_context}\n\n"
            )
    else:
        bill_context_section = ""

    fmt_kwargs = {
        "title": sanitized_title,
        "text": sanitized_text,
        "amendments_list": amendments_list,
        "bill_context_section": bill_context_section,
    }

    if lang == "cs":
        structured_system = _STRUCTURED_AMENDMENT_SUMMARIES_SYSTEM_CS
        structured_prompt_tpl = _STRUCTURED_AMENDMENT_SUMMARIES_PROMPT_CS
        freetext_system = _AMENDMENT_SUMMARIES_SYSTEM_CS
        freetext_prompt_tpl = _AMENDMENT_SUMMARIES_PROMPT_CS
    else:
        structured_system = _STRUCTURED_AMENDMENT_SUMMARIES_SYSTEM_EN
        structured_prompt_tpl = _STRUCTURED_AMENDMENT_SUMMARIES_PROMPT_EN
        freetext_system = _AMENDMENT_SUMMARIES_SYSTEM_EN
        freetext_prompt_tpl = _AMENDMENT_SUMMARIES_PROMPT_EN

    if self.supports_structured_output:
        prompt = structured_prompt_tpl.format(**fmt_kwargs)
        data = self._generate_json(prompt, structured_system, _AMENDMENT_SUMMARIES_SCHEMA)
        if data is not None:
            raw_letters = [item.get("letter", "") for item in data.get("amendments", [])]
            result = _parse_amendment_summaries_json(data)
            logger.info(
                "{} Amendment summaries ({}): {}/{} keys matched, raw letters={}",
                self._log_prefix,
                lang,
                len(result),
                len(raw_letters),
                raw_letters,
            )
            if result:
                return result
            logger.warning(
                "{} Amendment summaries ({}): structured JSON returned 0 matches, "
                "falling back to free-text",
                self._log_prefix,
                lang,
            )
        else:
            logger.warning(
                "{} Amendment summaries ({}): structured JSON returned None, "
                "falling back to free-text",
                self._log_prefix,
                lang,
            )

    # Free-text path (primary when structured output disabled, fallback otherwise)
    prompt = freetext_prompt_tpl.format(**fmt_kwargs)
    response = self._generate_with_retry(
        prompt,
        freetext_system,
        validator=lambda r: bool(_parse_amendment_summaries_text(r)),
    )
    if response is None:
        logger.warning(
            "{} Amendment summaries ({}): free-text also returned None",
            self._log_prefix,
            lang,
        )
        return {}
    result = _parse_amendment_summaries_text(response)
    logger.info(
        "{} Amendment summaries ({}): {} keys from free-text",
        self._log_prefix,
        lang,
        len(result),
    )
    return result
